30. a) Francis Biernat 
c) Supervisor, Milwaukee County
d) 133
e) Asked how noise levels would be affected by ramps at Howell Avenue. Questioned the effect on the learning and teaching process at Hamlin-Garland School. Proposed a tunnel section between I-94 and 14th Street.
f) A noise study was supposed to be done to predict the change in noise levels by the design change of adding ramps to Howell Avenue.
Stated his concern that the noise levels would disturb the learning and teaching processes at Hamlin-Garland School.
Proposed a 750' tunnel section from just east of I-94 to 14th Street at an additional cost of $5,000,000 to reduce the noise in the area.
g) A study of the increased noise because of the addition of access to Howell Avenue was conducted by the staff of the Milwaukee County Expressway and Transporation Commission. The results show an increase of less than 1 dBA along the Airport Spur. The results of this study are incorporated in this Final EIS. See pages 114 and 115.
See page 150 of this Final Environmental Impact Statement.
The noise abatement strategy outlined on page 150 would reduce the noise to acceptable Federal levels. It would also reduce the adverse impact on air quality and could be done at a lower cost than the proposed tunnel. Therefore, it is not economically justifiable.
